title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?
description: Seven real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, Kaiser Wilhelm II, King George V, Queen Elizabeth II, Barack Obama and Mike Myers.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?

image.file: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-S38324, Tag von Potsdam, Adolf Hitler, Paul v. Hindenburg.jpg

links.line: In 1933, Hitler shook hands with President Hindenburg, who had just made him chancellor.
In 1917, Hindenburg studied war maps with Kaiser Wilhelm II, Germany's last emperor.

image.file: File:The Nine Sovereigns at Windsor for the funeral of King Edward VII.jpg

links.line: In 1910, at a royal funeral at Windsor, the Kaiser posed with cousin King George V.

image.file: File:3-5 (i.e. 6)-33, anniversaire du roi George V (la famille royale au balcon de Buckingham Palace) - btv1b532749892.jpg

links.line: On his 1933 birthday, King George V stood on the palace balcony with granddaughter Princess Elizabeth.

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: Decades later, in 2009, Queen Elizabeth II welcomed President Barack Obama to Buckingham Palace.
In 2012, Mike Myers performed for Obama at a White House concert honoring Burt Bacharach.

research_note: The 1910 funeral of Edward VII put the Kaiser in one photo with his cousin George V, and the royals carry the chain to Obama.
fun_fact: Kaiser Wilhelm II and King George V were first cousins, both grandsons of Queen Victoria, yet led opposite sides in World War I.
